CustomField.description: When the work order was reported/synced from Yardi. Anchors all SLA math (used instead of CreatedDate so seed offsets are deterministic). Replaces Reported_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9. MIGRATION: optional only while Reported_Date__c still exists; both are written in parallel until the backfill completes, after which this field becomes required and Reported_Date__c is retired.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the work order was reported in Yardi. Every SLA calculation counts forward from this moment, so a wrong value silently re-tiers the work order's SLA health.
CustomField.label: Reported DateTime
